selected_primary_idea.title: Energy-to-Velocity Saturation Ledger for Constraint-Aware Accelerator Comparison
selected_primary_idea.summary: A computational, source-bounded framework that maps energy to beta and classifies the dominant non-kinematic accelerator constraint by architecture.
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: Once beta is sufficiently close to one under a declared saturation rule, speed does not discriminate credible concepts; a sensitivity-aware ledger of energy, rigidity, loss, power, beam quality, and protection does.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: Compare architecture-specific model cards under an explicitly declared variable and uncertainty schema.
falsifiers: speed-only metric remains discriminating after saturation
